output.population: Twelve observers took part in the Experiment (2 female; age range 21–25 years). All were right-handed, had normal or corrected-to-normal vision, and reported no history of neurological disorder
output.summary: Continuous 64-channel EEG with ICA weights, recorded while observers performed a visual dimension discrimination task. Originally published in 2010, later reused for classifying independent components, and converted to BIDS format.
